user.title: Samsung SmartTags Setup
user.description:
Choose manual cookie entry, or open one normal headed Chrome window with a persistent profile at `{profile}` and complete Samsung login yourself. The browser is never run headless, no stealth/anti-detection flags are used, and authentication is not retried automatically.

For manual entry, visit [SmartThings Find]({url}) and copy the **JSESSIONID** cookie from browser Developer Tools. Treat it like a password.
